notes: You need an account on the volunteer network site. Parks volunteer pages on the city site list events, camps and clean-ups but do not state ages.
name: City of Bloomington Volunteer Network
org: City of Bloomington, Community and Family Resources
what_you_do: A free site that lists volunteer jobs from 300 or more local nonprofits, plus events and trainings. You make an account and sign up for opportunities.
who_can_apply: The city says it connects volunteers of all ages. Each posting sets its own rules, so check the listing for age limits.
deadline_text: No deadline. Each opportunity has its own date.
how_to_apply: Search for chances at BloomingtonVolunteerNetwork.org. Make an account and sign up. Call the coordinator at 812-349-3433.
